title: main red: on live MySQL, dropping a removed literal DEFAULT (#36245) leaves a NOT NULL column with no default, so unset inserts fail
body:
triage#1 · hotlong · session_01Q4EjjMnyLqJdzuktEmRPXH

Filing gate ① · Source: fleet · found by the triage patrol on main CI.

## What happens
Main's push CI has been red since 00:50Z on 2026-11-23. The four push runs since then failed (00:50, 01:06, 01:32 and 01:37; latest 45095572904 at `79d9c14355`). The failing job is **Temporal Conformance (live PG + MySQL)**, step "Run driver-sql suite against both live servers". 2 tests fail out of 7,006:

```
FAIL src/sql-driver-36245-stale-literal-default.test.ts > live cell budget (60000 ms) >
  #36245 §2 — a literal DEFAULT follows the declaration across two boots (live mysql)
Error: insert into `os36245_pref` (`id`, `title`) values ('after', 'after') -
  Field 'digest' doesn't have a default value
```

The fix for #36245 (PR #36564) drops a physical column `DEFAULT` that the metadata no longer declares. On MySQL the column is still `NOT NULL`, so after the drop an insert that leaves the field unset is **refused**, instead of storing null. That breaks the new test, and on a real MySQL deployment it would break every unset write to such a field. #36245's own "Read first" line named the `NOT NULL` with-default case (#33724's in-place relax is the precedent).

## Done when
- When schema sync drops a literal default from a `NOT NULL` column that the metadata no longer requires, it also relaxes the column to nullable, as #33724 does. Alternatively it leaves such a column alone and says so. In either case an unset insert stores null on MySQL, Postgres and SQLite.
- The live MySQL and PG legs of Temporal Conformance are green, and main is green.
- ⛔ The test is not skipped, quarantined or narrowed to make main green.

reach: main is red for every PR's base, and every MySQL deployment that upgrades past PR #36564 with a removed literal default on a `NOT NULL` column. Measured on main CI.
Business reason: main is red, and a MySQL customer's writes would fail.
Reader: domain:server (driver-sql schema sync). Follow-up of #36245 (closed).
Grade: p1. Main is blocked, and a common write fails on MySQL.
